title: 伊芙琳·亮彩手绘 Sketch
description: 淡紫皮肤与洋红头发对比鲜明，两条渐细的背部附肢向外延伸。

art_direction.medium: bright colored-pencil sketch, confident graphite contours, visible cross-hatching and selective gouache on pale drawing paper
art_direction.identity: Evelynn is an adult lavender-skinned demon woman with swept magenta hair, bright golden eyes, pointed ears, and two long tapering lashers emerging from her back. Preserve her nonhuman identity without sexualized anatomy or seductive posing. A fully covering tailored violet coat, opaque trousers, gloves, and boots conceal torso and legs, while the lashers stay lowered in controlled separate curves with inactive tips.
art_direction.scene: An eye-level three-quarter turn, face off center, a sweeping contour linking the head to the defining motif in open pale paper. Build the composition around this champion's defining anatomy and core motif. Only a few light environment marks; keep the picture predominantly bright and colorful.
art_direction.palette: lavender, magenta, violet, amber edge light; high-value vivid local color, luminous warm-white paper, bright chromatic shadows, limited canonical dark details
art_direction.weapon_policy: iconic static prop, no attacks or firing

visual_qa.method: Compressed JPEG contact sheet, max edge 1280 and under 350 KB
